name: HaloShop_Bakery
note: Shop (24 x 15 x 18). Rect body 20 x 13.5, a 9.5-stud ground storey with a display window each side of the centred door (the 2D has ONE big shop window left of an off-centre door: the generator door is always centred, so the shopfront is mirrored), a short upper tier with the small arched window over the sign, gold corner pilasters, lantern pedestals, wide blue/white awning, two corner planters with topiary, flat roof with a solid parapet. Missing: gold sign plaque, raised arched gable with the round-top window, brick-red dome + chimney lantern tower, off-centre door, baker's display shelves, ivy on the corner posts (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloShop_Bakery_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG is not in the worktree.
